Name: Expansion Fish Redesign
Author: mrtaiyou
Description:
[center][b]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/zZCdv6w.png[/img]﻿﻿
-[/b][/center][center]﻿Hello visual mods lover[color=#e06666] [/color]:D! Welcome to my... sixth﻿ mod? Anyway,
i don't remember exactly how many things i did this year.
Those days i was bored and had nothing to do, until while exploring
the other mods page to give me creativity on how to improve mine.
I saw the fishs from RV and thought "i want to make them".
Said and done, in less than 1 hour i had redesigned all the fish.
So the 'Expansion Fish Redesign' mod redesign some fishs
(yup, i have a bad english)from expansion mods! "What expansion mods mean dude?"
Expansion mods are basically huge mods with a ton of new items,
npcs, locations, fishs, etc, but mine affect only the fishes.
I hope you all enjoy :3.
